c_m.data_reference: gentet2000direct; specific membrane capacitance 0.9 uF/cm^2 measured directly in nucleated patches of cortical pyramidal, spinal cord and hippocampal neurons (Abstract); 1 uF/cm^2 (0.01 pF/um^2) is the conventional value used here

d_ax.data_reference: definitional; axon diameter 1 um, within the 0.3-1.5 um range of unmyelinated postganglionic sympathetic axons; with L_ax and R_i chosen to reproduce the previous C and R

L_ax.data_reference: definitional; axon length chosen so that C = c_m pi d_ax L_ax reproduces the previous C = 10 pF (SN_simple to_be_determined C = 10 pF): L_ax = C/(c_m pi d_ax) = 318.3 um **Shortened on review 2026-10-06 to L/3 = 106.1 um so the lumped pseudo-axon passes the AP (effective time constant RC/(1+channel_ratio) 2.0 -> 0.22 ms, below the ~0.8 ms spike width; reviews/neuron_sympathetic_ap_transmission.html): L_ax is the electrotonic length of one lumped compartment, not the anatomical axon length**

R_i.data_reference: definitional; axial (cytoplasmic) resistivity chosen so that R = 4 R_i L_ax/(pi d_ax^2) reproduces the previous R = 300 MOhm (SN_simple to_be_determined R = 300 MOhm): R_i = 74.02 ohm cm (typical axoplasm 70-200 ohm cm)

V_in.data_reference: definitional; the input (soma) voltage, an input from the coupled soma; -70 mV (rest) when unconnected
